name: jse-tju-fit-positioning
description: Use when an author is deciding whether a systems, management-science, operations-research, engineering, control, or empirical manuscript genuinely fits 《系统工程学报》 (Journal of Systems Engineering, Tianjin University), or when a concrete rerouting decision is needed among Systems Engineering Theory and Practice, Journal of Management Sciences in China, Chinese Journal of Management Science, Systems Engineering and Electronics, Control and Decision, and Operations Research and Management Science.
